description: Internationalize a JavaScript application by extracting user-facing strings to a translation file. TASK: (1) Examine /home/ga/workspace/i18n_task/app.js to identify user-facing strings (error messages, UI labels, success messages) vs debug strings (console.log messages). (2) Create directory 'i18n' and file 'i18n/en.json' in the workspace. (3) Extract ALL user-facing strings to en.json with semantic keys like 'error.emptyCredentials', 'button.submit', 'success.loginWelcome', etc. Format: {"key": "value"}. (4) Add import at top of app.js: const { t } = require('./i18n'); (5) Replace each hardcoded user-facing string with t('key.name') using the keys from en.json. (6) Do NOT change console.log debug messages - leave them as hardcoded strings. (7) Ensure all keys used in code exist in en.json. (8) Save all files. EXPECTED: en.json with 5-7 translations, app.js with i18n import and t() calls replacing user strings, debug logs unchanged.
